title: Cold Weather
summary: Hedda sells eggs by Thornwick's well and says the weather listens to her. If your company holds out somewhere damp and cold, she'll teach your mages to call the frost (the mage's level-6 skill).

steps.journal: Hold six waves in the Sunken Chapel, in the marsh where the river leaves the Vale, out past the lumber camp.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Sunken Chapel

ready: Go back to Hedda, by the well in Thornwick.
done: Hedda taught your mages Frost Nova, and said it was only a hard frost, early. She said it about eggs, too.
